name: MD. Tanvir Shakil
title: Electronics & Embedded Systems Engineer | IoT / IIoT / AIoT | Embedded AI
tagline: I design and build embedded hardware, firmware, and AIoT systems — from multi-layer PCBs to edge intelligence — and I'm working toward graduate research in embedded AI for e-mobility and intelligent power electronics.
summary: Electronics Engineer with expertise in multi-layer PCB design, embedded systems, IoT/AIoT architectures, and embedded AI. Proven experience leading end-to-end hardware development, from system architecture and component selection to prototyping, validation, and deployment. Focused on advancing e-mobility, EV charging infrastructure, and smart power-electronic solutions through robust design, intelligent control, and high-reliability engineering practices.
researchFocusSummary: Embedded AI and AIoT for resource-constrained systems — spanning edge intelligence for industrial power monitoring, TinyML for low-power wearable sensing, and embedded control for e-mobility and smart power electronics.
currentFocus: Developing AI-driven embedded solutions for smart home electronics and intelligent automation at THT-Space Electrical Company Ltd. — designing AIoT-enabled devices with Wi-Fi/BLE/MQTT connectivity for real-time monitoring and control.
